answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism forces every identity to submit original jury-graded reasoning each epoch that incorporates a live randomness beacon. The beacon injects unique terms such as ferrous fable and saffron so duplicated answers are rejected by shingle collision checks. Creating many fake identities multiplies the required high-quality judgment work linearly; the attacker pays continuous computational cost proportional to Sybil count while honest agents pay only once.
